title: Friend spoke to Amy Eskridge hours before her death
summary: unnamed friend of Amy Eskridge tells of Friend spoke to Amy Eskridge hours before her death, about 2022 at Alabama, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I don't believe that she killed herself. I I just can't because I spoke to her four hours before and she told me time and time again, I'm not going to commit suicide.

plain: Amy Eskridge was a woman in Alabama whose death in 2022 was treated as a suicide, and a podcast episode by Jesse Michels about scientists going missing included a friend of hers who did not give a name. The friend says they spoke with her four hours before she died, and that she had said again and again that she would never kill herself. So the friend does not believe she took her own life, which would mean something else happened to her.
